title: WEF data-governance council member carryover root pass
summary: The cross-term roster root begins by separating dated person membership, undated direct person membership, organization membership and publication participation for the fragmented 2020-2021 Data Policy surface. Katherine Hsiao and JoAnn Stonier are already directly supported as Data Policy participants who also appear in the fixed 2023 Data Equity author/member set; broader carryover remains under enumeration.

data.question: Which people can be defensibly reconstructed on the 2020-2021 Data Policy council and which of them recur in later Data Equity and Data Frontiers generations?
data.method: Classify historical membership evidence before identity crossmatching against the fixed 2023-2024 Data Equity and current 2025-2026 Data Frontiers rosters.
data.scope: Public professional WEF data-governance council memberships from 2020 through 2026.
findings: Maria-Elena Torres-Padilla is directly dated to Data Policy membership in 2020-2021; Academia Europaea narrows this to October 2020 through September 2021.
Sina Fazelpour is identified by authoritative institutional biographies as the 2020-2021 Council Fellow on the Data Policy council.

WEF directly confirms historical Data Policy membership/service for Katherine Hsiao, JoAnn Stonier, Brett Solomon and Wafa Ben-Hassine, though the reviewed current profiles do not expose exact historical dates for all four.
WEF and Dawex state that Dawex joined the Data Policy council in 2020; this is modeled as organization-level membership unless a person-specific seat is independently documented.
Katherine Hsiao and JoAnn Stonier are directly present in both the recovered Data Policy membership evidence and the fixed 2023 Data Equity author/member set.
conclusions: The historical roster must remain evidence-typed rather than flattened into an apparently complete 30-person list.
At least two direct person-level carryovers from Data Policy to Data Equity are already source-supported: Hsiao and Stonier.
No continuity or influence claim is inferred from recurrence alone.
limitations: Archived WEF roster pages may be required to close the historical set and exact term dates.
unresolved: Exact dates for undated WEF-confirmed members
Potential Data Policy-to-Data Equity carryovers beyond Hsiao and Stonier

classification_rules: Dated person membership outranks undated current-profile historical claims.
Organization membership is not silently converted to person membership.
Publication participation is not council membership without independent confirmation.
Recurrence is not influence or continuous service.

Hsiao and Stonier are directly supported carryovers from Data Policy into the 2023 Data Equity member/author set.
